title: Basic Series Circuit
summary: A simple series circuit contains a battery B1, a switch S1 and a bulb L1 connected in one loop. The switch is open, so the circuit is incomplete and the bulb is off.

nodes.label: Battery B1
nodes.description: The battery provides electrical energy for this simple circuit.

nodes.label: Switch S1
nodes.description: A switch can open or close the circuit. It is initially open.

nodes.label: Bulb L1
nodes.description: The bulb turns on when the simple series circuit is complete.

edges.description: A wire connects Battery B1 to Switch S1.
A wire connects Switch S1 to Bulb L1.
The return wire connects Bulb L1 to Battery B1.
